comment.body: Thanks for the bug-report ZIP. When Peek next stops working, could you note the approximate time and confirm whether it followed sleep/resume, lock/unlock, Explorer restart, monitor changes, or a PowerToys update? Please check whether PowerToys.Peek.UI.exe is still running, whether Ctrl+Space does anything for multiple file types, and whether restarting Explorer alone restores it. A second bug report captured immediately after the failure would let us align the logs to that timestamp.
